scripts.build:e2e: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL= NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 E2E_MODE=true next build --webpack
scripts.start:e2e: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL= NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 NODE_OPTIONS=--inspect=9230 NODE_V8_COVERAGE=coverage/e2e/raw/server next start --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3100
